messages.author: Vaibhav Dixit
messages.body:
Dear All,
I'm facing a strange error with tleap which was not appearing a few days
ago.
I didn't alter any installation or configuration parameters nor paths, thus
don't understand why I'm getting this error using mol2 and frcmod files
which were working fine earlier.
Earlier posts on the list suggest running parmchk2 which shouldn't really
be required since these files worked earlier nicely without a problem.
Any suggestions on what might be wrong here will really be appreciated.
Looking forward to valuable suggestions from the list.
Thank you and best regards.

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
since it's complaining about missing parameters, you might check the part
of the output that you didn't include, such as the response from leap when
you tell it to load the files that should have these parameters. Did you
previously have a leaprc file in the directory where you ran it, and do not
any more? I suggest checking the parts that load parameters, such as the
leap input, the leaprc, and possibly your AMBERHOME.
